entry.title: New: dsh-wallpaper-engine
entry.summary: Use wallpapers downloaded in Wallpaper Engine as the DeepSeek Harness web background: video wallpapers play in place, image wallpapers use the highest-resolution standalone artwork, with cover/contain fit modes and a 0-100 panel dimmer. Exact install spec: github:sakuraaa667/dsh-wallpaper-engine. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
